bio.text: Jack Ladyman represents District 32 in the Arkansas House of Representatives, which includes part of Craighead County, and has served in the House since 2015.

Ladyman has an associate degree from Williams Baptist College and a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Arkansas, Fayetteville, and is an engineer for Nordex in Jonesboro, where he lives.
